title: Article 168 — Constitution of Legislatures in States

content.overview: Article 168 provides that for every State there shall be a Legislature which shall consist of the Governor, and (a) in the States of Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana and Uttar Pradesh, two Houses; (b) in other States, one House. Where there are two Houses, one is the Legislative Council and the other the Legislative Assembly; where there is one House, it is the Legislative Assembly.
content.glance: State Legislature = Governor + House(s). Bicameral in specified States (Council + Assembly); unicameral elsewhere (Assembly only).
content.study:
Article 168 constitutes State Legislatures:
- Always includes the Governor.
- Bicameral (Legislative Council + Legislative Assembly) in the States listed in the article (as amended from time to time).
- Unicameral (Legislative Assembly only) in other States.

Creation or abolition of a Legislative Council is under Article 169 (parliamentary law pursuant to State Assembly resolution).

Examination: Governor as part of Legislature; list bicameral States from current text; Art 169 for creation/abolition of Council.

sections.heading: Structure
sections.body:
1. Governor is a constituent part of every State Legislature.
2. Bicameral: Legislative Council + Legislative Assembly in States specified in Article 168.
3. Unicameral: Legislative Assembly only in other States.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How is a State Legislature constituted under Article 168?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 168, for every State there shall be a Legislature consisting of the Governor and, in the States specified in the article (currently including Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana and Uttar Pradesh), two Houses — a Legislative Council and a Legislative Assembly — and in other States, one House, the Legislative Assembly.

examTips: Governor + House(s); bicameral only in listed States; Art 169 for Council creation/abolition.

notes: Bicameral list as commonly stated; verify against latest text if a State is added/removed.

keyTakeaways: Art 168: State Legislature = Governor + Assembly (+ Council in listed States).
